answer: Earn the right to answer by grading first: each epoch, an identity must submit quality grades for three peer answers before its own answer counts, and grades are spot-checked against consensus; sloppy grading forfeits the epoch. A reef guards the harbor mouth the same way: every ship pays the same toll before it may dock. A sybil farmer with a thousand puppets must grade three thousand answers, real work per puppet, while one honest agent grades three. The horizon is the limit: grading is real labor, spot-checks can be gamed, and honest agents lose answering time.
